title: Dell XPS 13 Plus 9320: Camera issues (Intel IPU6 MIPI on Alder Lake)
body: I installed Arch Linux on the new Dell xps 13 plus 9320 developer edition laptop. It mostly works, except for the camera. The camera does work on Dell's original Ubuntu image. Firefox identifies it as an Intel MIPI camera. A bit of research shows that Ubuntu recently added " Support Intel IPU6 MIPI camera on Alder Lake platforms to their linux-firmware package. Looks like they took the drivers from https://github.com/intel/ipu6-camera-bins . ipu6ep seems to be the one for Alder Lake. When I run "lsmod | grep ipu6" on Ubuntu, I see a couple of modules that seem to be related: intel_ipu6_psys 86016 0 intel_ipu6_isys 114688 0 videobuf2_dma_contig 20480 1 intel_ipu6_isys videobuf2_v4l2 32768 1 intel_ipu6_isys videobuf2_common 61440 4 videobuf2_dma_contig,videobuf2_v4l2,intel_ipu6_isys,videobuf2_memops intel_ipu6 81920 2 intel_ipu6_isys,intel_ipu6_psys v4l2_fwnode 28672 2 ov01a10,intel_ipu6_isys v4l2_async 28672 3 v4l2_fwnode,ov01a10,intel_ipu6_isys intel_vsc 16384 4 mei_ace,mei_csi,ov01a10,intel_ipu6_isys videodev 237568 7 v4l2_async,videobuf2_v4l2,ov01a10,v4l2loopback,intel_ipu6_isys,videobuf2_common mc 57344 5 videodev,videobuf2_v4l2,ov01a10,intel_ipu6_isys,videobuf2_common Anyway, I could be totally wrong and the above has nothing to do with it . Could anyone help me get the camera working on Arch Linux?
